article.title: PM De Wever eyes €10bn in cuts: “Everyone’s going to feel the pinch”
article.summary: Everybody in Belgium will feel the impact of the federal government’s imminent decisions to shore up the country’s national finances says Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever (Flemish nationalist N-VA). The federal PM was speaking on the French-medium independent radio station Bel RTL. “It’s keeping me awake at night; I think about it often,” the Prime Minister said.

article.title: Belgium Prime Minister to arrive in India on first official visit this week
article.summary: New Delhi, Aug 31:At the invitation of the Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Belgium, H.E. Bart De Wever, will undertake an official visit to India from 02 - 04 September 2026. Prime Minister De Wever would be accompanied by the Belgian Minister of Defence, H.E. Theo Francken.This will be Prime Minister De Wever’s first visit to India since taking office in February 2025.During the visit, Prime Minister De Wever is scheduled to hold bilateral talks with Prime Minister Modi on 03 September to discuss the entire spectrum of bilateral relations, as well as, regional and global issues of mutual interest. Prime Minister De Wever will also deliver a keynote address at a Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) business event, in the context of the India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA).
